sources.facts: INAH identifies Moon pyramid at northern end of Avenue of the Dead, gives height over45m and rounded140x150m base. These are general public dimensions, not measured terrace profiles.

INAH researcher Veronica Ortega Cabrera identifies Structure A as a separate building12m south of the platform attached to Moon pyramid. Exclude that building and independent plaza altars/pyramids from this structure.

limits: Text facts only; official protected images/plans not used. Preserve native144x157m whole outline rather than fitting to rounded base figures.
